title_en: Last Night I Passed by Your Gate
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Сношти' and 'порте' are dialectal forms; 'од теб' не се делам' read as 'I cannot part from you'.

lines.cyr: Сношти минав покрај ваш'то порте либе
lines.lat: Snošti minav pokraj vaš'to porte libe
lines.en: Last night I passed by your gate, love,
you were standing at the gate,
oh, I am dying, love, I am perishing,

lines.cyr: и од теб' не се делам.
lines.lat: i od teb' ne se delam.
lines.en: and I cannot part from you.

lines.cyr: Јас ти реков: „Добро вечер, мило либе“,
lines.lat: Jas ti rekov: „Dobro večer, milo libe“,
lines.en: I said to you: 'Good evening, dear love,'
you raised your head and looked at me,
oh, I am dying, love, I am perishing,

lines.cyr: и од теб' не се делам.
lines.lat: i od teb' ne se delam.
lines.en: and I cannot part from you.

lines.cyr: Бог да бие твојта мајка мило либе
lines.lat: Bog da bie tvojta majka milo libe
lines.en: May God strike your mother, dear love,
for she parted the two of us,
oh, I am dying, love, I am perishing,

lines.cyr: и од теб' не се делам.
lines.lat: i od teb' ne se delam.
lines.en: and I cannot part from you.

lines.cyr: Бог да бие твојта мајка, а и татко
lines.lat: Bog da bie tvojta majka, a i tatko
lines.en: May God strike your mother, and your father too,
for they parted the two of us,
oh, I am dying, love, I am perishing,

lines.cyr: и од теб' не се делам.
lines.lat: i od teb' ne se delam.
lines.en: and I cannot part from you.
